units.source_text: 阿笑在阿泷尖利的目光的逼视下，依然心荡神驰地从温泉里走出来，坐在澡塘边上。

en.t: Under A-Taki's sharp, pressing stare, A-Xiao still came out of the hot spring as if her heart had been carried away, and sat down at the edge of the bath.

units.source_text: 她水灵灵的肌肤，宛如一只羞白的蛞蝓，令人感到她体态丰腴，没有一丁点污垢，柔软而圆润。

en.t: Her fresh, moist skin was like a shy white slug, giving the impression that her body was full and ample, without the slightest trace of dirt, soft and rounded.

units.source_text: 那身脂肪犹如蜗牛肉，伸缩自如，像是一只爬行动物。

en.t: The fat on her body was like the flesh of a snail, freely stretching and contracting, as though she were some crawling creature.

units.source_text: 阿泷恨不得在她那白净的腹部上跺它几脚……

en.t: A-Taki could hardly resist stamping several times on that fair, clean belly of hers...

units.source_text: 阿泷好像遭到男人那种情欲的突然袭击，使劲把手伸到阿笑的膝上。

en.t: As if suddenly seized by that kind of male desire, A-Taki thrust her hand with all her strength onto A-Xiao's knee.
